items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Oh, the publisher, he arranged it.

ctx.x: wonderful ideas, a wonderful drive in all of that that nobody else quite matched. I don't believe anybody else quite matched that drive you had on those Jelly Roll Martin records.

They were wonderful. Yeah, well I made quite a few records with the General. Some of them that I'd never heard because just as I say, he'd have records to make and he'd call me and I'd go down and rehearse with him and make the records and I'd forget about it. He had records out that I didn't know, didn't know about, you know, forgot about. Where did they rehearse? Well we rehearsed it, let's see, where did we rehearse? We had a... I wonder if you went to his home or if you went to a studio or... No, no, no, we…
Yeah. Um, was that the Victor Studio, was it up on Oak Street or on Washington in those days? I don't remember, I wasn't here those days, I didn't...
